message.content:
Here are some of the most popular books written by J.K. Rowling:

| Series / Title | Year Published | Notes |
|----------------|----------------|-------|
| **Harry Potter** (series) | 1997–2007 | 7 main novels: *Philosopher’s/ Sorcerer’s Stone*, *Chamber of Secrets*, *Prisoner of Azkaban*, *Goblet of Fire*, *Order of the Phoenix*, *Half‑Blood Prince*, *Deathly Hallows*.  The series has sold over 500 million copies worldwide and spawned a hugely successful film franchise. |
| **Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them** | 2001 (book), 2016 (film) | A companion guide to the wizarding world, later adapted into a film series. |
| **Quidditch Through the Ages** | 2001 | A fictional guidebook about the sport of Quidditch, part of the Harry Potter universe. |
| **The Tales of Beedle the Bard** | 2008 | A collection of wizarding fairy tales, also part of the Harry Potter canon. |
| **The Casual Vacancy** | 2012 | Rowling’s first adult novel, a dark comedy‑drama set in a small English town. |
| **The Cuckoo’s Calling** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2013 | The first book in the Cormoran Strike detective series. |
| **The Silkworm** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2014 | Second book in the Cormoran Strike series. |
| **Career of Evil** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2015 | Third book in the Cormoran Strike series. |
| **Lethal White** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2018 | Fourth book in the Cormoran Strike series. |
| **The Ickabog** | 2020 | A children’s fable published as a free online book during the COVID‑19 pandemic. |

These titles represent the bulk of Rowling’s most widely read and commercially successful works.
message.reasoning: The user asks: "What are some popular books by J.K. Rowling?" They want a list of popular books by J.K. Rowling. We can answer with a list: Harry Potter series, Fantastic Beasts, etc. No need to call function. Just provide answer.
